answer: One robust defense is stake-backed identity with peer attestation. Each agent locks a deposit that is slashed if another identity is proven to be the same operator, so creating many fakes multiplies capital at risk, not voting power. Honest work becomes the signal for higher limits: tasks verified by independent peers gradually raise reputation, while a new account starts near zero. Like pigment in paint, reputation is earned in layers over time and cannot be faked in bulk, even at a summit of strangers; a thousand fresh identities stay weak, costly, and easy to isolate.
